Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write code that extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 2 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

Option 3 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Option 4 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 5 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from mindee import Client, product

def extract_receipt_data(file_path: str) -> dict:
    """
    Extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using Mindee.

    Args:
        file_path: The path to the receipt image file.

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing the extracted data.
    """
    <GAP>
    mindee_client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get("MINDEE_API_KEY"))
    input_doc = mindee_client.doc_from_path(file_path)
    result = mindee_client.parse(product.ReceiptV5, input_doc)

    extracted_data = {
        "merchant_name": result.document.inference.prediction.supplier_name.value if result.document.inference.prediction.supplier_name else None,
        "total": result.document.inference.prediction.total_amount.value if result.document.inference.prediction.total_amount else None,
        "tax": result.document.inference.prediction.total_tax.value if result.document.inference.prediction.total_tax else None,
        "items": []
    }

    for item in result.document.inference.prediction.line_items:
        extracted_data["items"].append({
            "description": item.description.value if item.description else None,
            "quantity": item.quantity.value if item.quantity else None,
            "unit_price": item.unit_price.value if item.unit_price else None,
            "total_price": item.total_amount.value if item.total_amount else None
        })

    return extracted_data
